from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=programs/'task-f597e3cc.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    # Infer the field color, then mark the trailing field-color segment of
    # any left-aligned partial horizontal stripe with color 1.
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if not row or row[0] == background:
            continue
        color = row[0]
        i = 0
        while i < len(row) and row[i] == color:
            i += 1
        if 0 < i < len(row) and all(v == background for v in row[i:]):
            out[r][i:] = [1] * (len(row) - i)
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path, program_path.exists())
